title: Elux Firerose 5000 Bubblegum Airways 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bubblegum Airways from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection stands out from the pack with its innovative blend of flavours. The vibrant, nostalgic sweetness of fruit-infused bubblegum is the star of this flavour, providing a playful and sugary base. This sweetness is expertly balanced with a refreshing layer of cool mint, adding a crisp and clean dimension to the vape. The icy finish in Bubblegum Airways elevates the entire flavour profile, creating an exhilarating cooling sensation that complements both the sweet bubblegum and the refreshing mint. This unique combination makes for an endlessly enjoyable and multi-layered vaping experience, appealing to those who love a sweet yet refreshing vape with a distinctive twist. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices.
